protocol.mapping: fixed B: next=(previous+2)%3; no label supplied to a fly
protocol.teacherBudget: load archived reward-trained teacher 830; no teacher retraining
protocol.source: frozen 680ms real MBON Q; approve iff proposed Q exceeds both others
protocol.receiver: DNge175 3141 reject/0, 3165 approve/1; 300Hz 240-280ms; measured spike counts
protocol.student: one 24-round training episode, three MBON features and original alpha .03/epsilon .20 Q update
protocol.schedule: both cue 0-240ms at 150Hz, count reset 50ms, proposal 240ms, DN 240-280ms, final action/reward 280ms, Q update 620ms, end 680ms; student Network.resetState() only between rounds
protocol.streams: teacher base=830*1e7+episodeKey*1000+round; neural key+1, action key+501; student base=seed*1e7+episodeKey*1000+round; neural key+2, proposal key+501, fallback key+701; probe keys 200-235; evaluation keys 100-102; shuffle rng(2026110601+seed)
